contradict_criteria: Contradicts pipeline-saturated hypothesis if bounded profiling shows divergent dynamic limiters beyond paired MAD: e.g., high async-wait stalls, low MMA/HMMA utilization, or excess predicate/address cycles in baseline vs trusted-compute, indicating a transformable bottleneck rather than compiler-absorbed equivalence.
correctness_plan: Require PASS fp16 correctness vs reference with allclose for any profiled binary; verify divisible shape 512%64==0, 3072%128==0, 768%32==0 still masks correctly and has no OOB loads under instrumentation; reject runs with compile failure or correctness FAIL.
difference_from_previous: No new Triton math variant or loop rewrite. Read-only diagnostic of the already-reviewed baseline and trusted-compute binaries, unlike prior mask-hoisting with num_stages hint, two-slab unrolling with paired loads/dots, and split-K CTA restructuring that changed code and compared median speedups.
expected_performance_mechanism: No direct speedup is predicted. Profiling separates measured stall causes such as MMA issue vs cp.async wait vs predicate overhead from predicted gains, to gate future transforms and avoid repeating resource-heavy unrolls that increased registers and shared memory.
measurement_plan: Same GPU RTX 4060 Ti, same launcher_source_sha256 and baseline_source_sha256, same numeric config block_m64 block_n128 block_k32 num_stages3 num_warps4 on shape [512,3072,768]; bounded paired trials with python_launch_cuda_event reporting median_paired_speedup, paired_ratio_mad and aa_median_absolute_ratio_deviation without pooling absolute times across runs; plus Matmul Inspector PTX/SASS counts and bounded Nsight Compute throughput/stall sampling.
optimization_mechanism: Diagnostic only with no logic change: compare static occupancy from registers/shared and PTX/SASS async-copy and mma.sync counts with dynamic warp, MMA, and async-pipeline stall breakdown for baseline vs hoisted binary.
reasoning_from_evidence: Measured: trusted-compute screening 1.002391 with paired_ratio_mad 0.04185 exceeding effect and aa deviation 0.03841, outcome inconclusive; compiler_evidence shows matching PTX multisets with 18 cp.async copies, 32 mma.sync, 12 ldmatrix and identical 120 registers and 24576 shared bytes, so source hoisting was compiler-absorbed. Measured: trusted-two-slab loss 0.94736 with 120 to 129 registers and 24576 to 49152 shared and doubled mma sites, showing unrolling cost. Measured: split-K loss 0.835876. Predicted: profiling will show equivalent throughput/stall mix within A/A noise, which differs from prior attempts by diagnosing rather than rewriting, preventing repeat of low-value pipeline edits.
research_question: For 512x3072x768 fp16 baseline with 64x128x32 tiles, num_stages 3, num_warps 4, is the K-loop limited by MMA issue, async-copy pipeline stalls, or mask/predicate overhead given source-level mask hoisting left compiled PTX unchanged?
risks_and_uncertainties: A/A variation 0.038-0.048 observed exceeds 0.2% effects, so small differences remain within noise even with paired ratios and MAD.
Static PTX/SASS counts do not prove overlap; dynamic counters are needed but may be sensitive to profiling overhead and timing method.
A finding of already-pipelined equivalence rules out further hoist/unroll tweaks but does not by itself identify the next productive tuning direction.
support_criteria: Supports hypothesis if profiled baseline and trusted-compute show equivalent MMA/async throughput and stall mix within A/A noise and Inspector confirms identical 18 cp.async, 32 mma.sync, 120 registers and 24576 shared bytes with screening_only inconclusive result.

supporting_evidence.why_relevant: Independently reviewed mask-hoisting shows 1.002x within noise with large MAD and identical compiled resources, proving source change was absorbed and motivating diagnostic over another rewrite.
Reviewed two-slab unrolling shows screening loss 0.947 with increased registers and doubled shared memory, showing resource-heavy K-loop transforms hurt and need profiling gate.
Reviewed split-K on same shape shows screening loss 0.835, ruling out K-parallelism and narrowing next step to in-CTA pipeline diagnosis.

technical_hypothesis: Independent profiling of the reviewed baseline will show the K-loop is already pipelined with equivalent async-copy and MMA behavior to the hoisted variant, and residual predicate logic is not the dynamic limiter, so further mask-hoist or unroll source edits without resource change will remain within A/A noise.
